stories.title: Alumni stories
stories.intro: Wherever life takes them, our alumni carry Lawrence with them — the lessons, the friendships, the values and the person they are today.

items.name: Ananya Rao
items.quote: My years at Lawrence gave me a strong foundation, wonderful friendships and the confidence to chase my dreams. The nurturing environment here helped me discover my interests and believe in myself.

items.name: Rohan Mehta
items.quote: Lawrence taught me the importance of discipline, curiosity and kindness. The values I learnt here continue to guide me in every step of my journey. I am grateful to my teachers who always encouraged me to do my best.

items.name: Meera Nair
items.quote: Lawrence gave me a space to learn, grow and explore my passions. The support from teachers and the friendships I built here will always remain a special part of my life.

items.name: Arjun Singh
items.quote: From sports to academics, Lawrence helped me develop confidence, resilience and a love for learning. The experiences here shaped who I am today.

items.name: Neha Varghese
items.quote: The values, teachers and opportunities at Lawrence helped me become a better version of myself. I will always be proud to be a Lawrencian.
